spec.assertion: Generic critRatePct 2.62 with maxStacks 5 / durationSec 5 applied to all 4 roster slugs incl self; stacks observed reaching 5; window asserted at exactly 300 frames; durationShots must be absent (seconds, not rounds). RED under: critRateNormalPct scoping (asserted absent from the override), maxStacks 1 (patched run must be strictly weaker), value 0 (patched run must be strictly weaker), and an allies-minus-self target set.

Activation count over 180 s must fall in [10,150]. leona fires 10 pellets per shell, so a hitCount trigger that counts PELLET hits fires ~10x too often (~250-600) while any plausible round-counting encoding (hitCount 5 on rounds, or shotFired + everyN 5) lands ~25-60. RED under the pellet-counting reading; the band is deliberately loose because SG pulls/sec is a ⚑ datamine-unreliable field.
Zeroing the 2.62 crit value must lower team total damage but must leave the full-burst count identical — proves the buff is wired to the crit roll and not to burst generation.

No StatKey expresses effective range (range bands and the +30% full-range bonus are engine-owned, surfaced only as damage-event rangeApplied), so the line is unrepresentable. Active assertion: the override must ACKNOWLEDGE it (unmodeled/note/caveats mention range, or a block encodes something range-flavored) — the no-silent-drops check. Mechanism itself it.skip.

hitRatePct 20.28 applies exactly FB_STARTS times to leona, to all 4 slugs, ON the fullBurstStart frame (within 2 frames), 600-frame window. RED under a burstCast keying (apply would sit ~52 frames early and fire only on rotations she bursts) and under a self-only or SG-only mis-scope. Damage direction only (zeroing must lower leona total) because the HitRate-to-core magnitude is ⚑ engine-owned (hrCoreMult).

pelletCountFlat value 5 emitted once per full burst with a 600-frame window; zeroing must lower leona total, leave every teammate total byte-identical, and leave the full-burst count unchanged (pellets are damage-only, gauge is per-trigger). RED under a normalAttackPct proxy (damage-equivalent here, so the discriminator is the emitted stat key) and under any encoding that pumps gauge.

TargetDef has no combined top-ATK-AND-weapon kind (alliesTopAtk byFinalAtk OR alliesOfWeapon SG, not both). Enforced part: the target set must contain leona, be at most 2 slugs, and be a strict subset of the roster (rejects an all-allies mis-scope). Unenforceable part it.skip: leona is the only shotgun in controlComp so both candidate encodings collapse to the same single target; separating them needs a 3-plus-shotgun comp.

critDamagePct 34.64 to all 4 slugs, count at most FB_STARTS, and the apply must sit BEFORE the next fullBurstStart by 10-180 frames (the measured B2-cast-to-FB chain) and never on the fbStart frame. RED under a fullBurstEnter keying, which is the nearest-wrong model and over-credits in any comp where another Burst II completes the chain. Guarded by it.runIf: crown is also a Burst II here, so if leona never casts, the complementary branch asserts the block is encoded.

The 21.32 / 10 s critRatePct effect must exist in the burst slot (a dropped 21.32% team crit line is a real faithfulness loss), and where it fires its target set must be a strict subset of the roster containing leona — rejecting an all-allies mis-scope of the shotgun-only clause.

No primitive gates a block on another buff reaching maxStacks (resourceGate reads a resource pool; Roar decays 5 s after each activation so a pool cannot mirror it). it.skip with the reason, plus the noted near-inertness: 25 or more shells precede the first burst, so Roar is at 5 stacks whenever she casts, making an unconditional model a near-zero-error approximation.

fixtures: controlComp('leona', true) only — liter(B1) / crown(B2) / leona(carry) / helm(B3, SR/Water), deterministic (no seed), 5 hoisted 180 s runs: baseline plus four single-value counterfactuals (Roar crit 2.62 -> 0; Roar maxStacks 5 -> 1; hitRatePct -> 0; pelletCountFlat -> 0). The helm slot stays ON because leona is a Burst II and a comp with no Burst III chains nothing (zero full bursts would make every S2/burst assertion vacuous). Two fixture properties are load-bearing and both are exploited deliberately: (1) leona is the ONLY shotgun, so SG-scoped lines must land on a strict subset of the roster containing her — that is the all-allies mis-scope discriminator, and it is also why the 2-top-ATK-SG target set is untestable here; (2) crown is also a Burst II, so leona may never win the B2 slot — the burst-slot behavioural assertions run under it.runIf(she cast) with a complementary encoded-ness branch, so the file cannot silently pass vacuously. Roster slugs are never hardcoded: they are read from Object.keys(totals(res)), so teammate-identity guesses cannot cause a false failure. The event hook is wired at both opts.onEvent and opts.cfg.onEvent with identity dedupe, and the override slot shape is read tolerantly (Block[] or { blocks: Block[] }), for the same reason.
gaps: S1b Maximum Effective Range ▲20% for 10 sec (SG allies) — it.skip: no StatKey expresses effective range; range bands and the +30% full-range bonus are engine-owned (only observable as damage-event rangeApplied). Replaced by an active no-silent-drop check that the override acknowledges the line.

S2b target set '2 ally units with the highest final ATK and a Shotgun' — it.skip on the top-ATK-vs-all-SG discrimination: TargetDef has no combined top-ATK-AND-weapon kind, and controlComp contains exactly one shotgun so both encodings resolve identically. Needs a 3-plus-shotgun comp; the at-most-2 / strict-subset / contains-leona parts ARE asserted.

Burst 'Activates when Roar is at max stacks' gate — it.skip: no primitive gates a block on another buff reaching maxStacks (resourceGate reads a resource pool and Roar decays 5 s after each activation). Documented as near-inert: 25 or more shells precede the first burst, so Roar sits at 5 stacks at cast time.

Frame-window assertions (300 f for Roar, 600 f for the three 10 s buffs) and the burst-cast-precedes-FB timing check run under it.runIf(HAS_FRAMES) — buffApply carries expiresFrame in the documented shape but a per-event frame field is not documented, so the checks self-disable rather than fail spuriously if absent.
Hit-Rate to core-rate magnitude is asserted by DIRECTION only (⚑ hrCoreMult is an engine-owned derived value, HRCORE-gated); no magnitude claim is made.
